narrative:
## Handover Summary — Workforce & Clinical Staffing

The workforce plan is locked at about 18.0K FTE and GBP 780M people cost.

## Key Decisions
- 220 weekly agency carer shifts converted to permanent bank staff
- 38 additional associate dentists and hygienists for private dental demand
- Cromwell theatre lists consolidated to cut overtime premium

## Recommendations for Opex & Capex
- Fund the clinic roll-out pre-opening costs from the dental and clinic revenue case
- Prioritise digital investment that reduces manual claims handling

## Risk Factors
- Theatre nurse shortage in London
- Associate dentist recruitment lead times of four to six months
